oneLine: A new piece of work moves through fixed steps, each with a doer and a due time. A tick on one step puts the next person's step on their screen.
removes: Work stops between two people, and nobody notices.
A lead goes quiet between two people and nobody notices.
You find out when the client does.

oneLine: Referral partners kept in tiers, each with a monthly touchpoint that comes up by itself.
removes: Partners hear from you only when you need something.

oneLine: Every job type has a document list in three priorities: needed now, needed for the decision, collected along the way. Each item has an owner and a chase date.
removes: You ask the client for everything at once and get nothing.

oneLine: One format and one short standard procedure per repeated task, so every proposal and note comes out the same way.
removes: Every proposal is written differently, and you correct each one.
Everyone does the same job a different way.

oneLine: A big job tracked stage by stage, with each stage's owner and date in view.
removes: Big jobs drift, stage to stage.

oneLine: Each person opens one screen: today's routines, the steps due and the tasks given to them.
removes: People wait to be told what to do.
You gave it on Monday. On Friday, it has not started.

oneLine: Each repeating task has a person and a repeat rule, and appears on the right day by itself.
removes: Repeating work gets skipped, and nobody notices until it matters.

oneLine: A task given once gets one owner and one date, written down where both can see it.
removes: A task given by voice is forgotten by Friday.
You say everything twice.

oneLine: Late work gets a WhatsApp or email nudge. If it still stalls, a coordinator calls the doer and sets a new time. The owner is not called.
removes: You are the follow-up department.
Seven in the evening, and you are still asking whether it is done.

oneLine: A score from 0 to 100 for every person, every week: done on time, out of given.
removes: Appraisals are a debate with no record.
Who actually did what?

oneLine: The whole business on one screen: what is late, what is waiting, who is carrying what.
removes: A client tells you about a delay before your team does.
You find out last.

oneLine: Questions for the owner wait in one tray and are answered in one sitting.
removes: Your door does not stay closed for ten minutes.
Ten questions before lunch, each needing you now.

oneLine: Late items, decisions needed and new work, in one weekly meeting, for what only the owner can decide.
removes: Every decision reaches you, all day.

oneLine: Campaigns, posts and events tracked with stages and owners.
removes: Campaigns start and fade.

oneLine: Job post to offer, with a technical test built from the role's own template, so you see the work before you hire.
removes: A good interview. A month later, they cannot do the job.
You learn a month after hiring that they cannot do the job.

oneLine: Documents, access, introductions and training for a new joiner, as a checklist with owners.
removes: A new joiner's first week depends on who is free.

oneLine: Every template has a written lesson a new hire reads on day one. Write the lesson once; everyone learns from it.
removes: Training takes your best people off work.
The new joiner shadows your best person for a month.

oneLine: Who can do which process, and where the gaps are.
removes: You do not know who else can do a job when someone is away.

oneLine: Every asset with a tag, an owner and an audit date.
removes: Nobody knows who has which laptop.

oneLine: Every change recorded, nothing overwritten. Editing a process does not disturb work in progress.
removes: When something goes wrong, nobody can say what happened.

oneLine: Each product has a maximum. Every evening the closing stock gets a colour, and the colour says buy, hold or sell down.
removes: Out of what sells. Full of what does not.
Your cash is sitting in the godown.

oneLine: Who to pay, how much, and in what order, as cash comes in.
removes: Every vendor calls on the same day.
You pay whoever shouts loudest.
